author: Zach Hynek
headline: Land your next job using proven resume templates you can steal and design in minutes.
intro: Pick a resume that works for you, upload or enter your information, and have a perfectly well-designed resume in minutes.

principles.title: Give the reader a direction.
principles.body: Choose a role, team, or program before you choose your words. Use your introduction to connect the experience you have to the work you want to do.

principles.title: Put evidence next to the claim.
principles.body: What did you improve, build, sell, or help someone achieve? Add a result and its context. If you don’t have a number, describe an observable change. Never invent one.

principles.title: Make your contribution clear.
principles.body: Separate what the organization did from what you did. Say whether you led, supported, built, or collaborated. Give the team credit while making your role easy to see.

principles.title: Tailor the emphasis. Keep the facts.
principles.body: A sales role and a graduate program need different evidence. Reorder the story for the reader, then check your dates, titles, numbers, and spelling before you send it.
